titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦孝文王元年: notes

div.interp: The first and only year of King Xiaowen of Qin, 250 BC.
修先王功臣: 修 here is to attend to, to treat well.
弛苑囿: 弛, to relax; the enclosed parks and preserves of the king were opened.
十月: the Qin year began with the tenth month, so this October stands at the head of the year; the month began in what is, by the Julian reckoning, late October 251 BC.
三日: the third day counting from the accession day, Jihai, Gengzi, Xinchou.
The sixteenth year of King Xiaocheng of Zhao, 250 BC.
武襄: the Zhengyi: 襄 means to raise up, to be above, the title saying that Yue Cheng's merit was the highest.

The Jijie, Xu Guang: 尉文 is the name of a town; the Suoyin: 信平 is a title; the Hanshu's table has a Marquis Jie of Weiwen 尉文节侯, placed in Nan Commandery, so probably 尉 is an office and 文 a name, and the town that Wen had held in fief was given anew to Po, who was then styled Lord Xinping.
所母: the mother by adoption, Queen Huayang, as against the 真母, the real mother; the Suoyin: Liu's text reads 所生母, with 生 an intrusive character, and the editions it checked have no 生.
